title: German Crumble Apple Strudel
description: A classic German pastry filled with apples and topped with a crumbly streusel topping.
instructions: Roll out the flaky pastry dough to a thickness of 1/8 inch.
In a large bowl, mix together the sliced apples, sugar, and cinnamon.
Place the apple mixture onto one half of the pastry dough, leaving a 1-inch border around the edges.
Fold the other half of the pastry dough over the apple mixture and press the edges to seal.
Roll out the crumbly streusel topping and cut into small pieces.
Sprinkle the streusel topping over the pastry dough, leaving a small border around the edges.
Bake the strudel for 35-40 minutes, or until the pastry is golden brown and the apples are tender.
Remove the strudel from the oven and sprinkle with a pinch of pepper for garnish.
